settings.heading: Why only one box
settings.body:
Gift shops solve the wrong problem. They give you forty things and leave you to assemble a gift out of them, which is the part that actually takes the effort. Whether the candle goes with the tea. Whether three items looks mean. Whether the whole thing reads as considered or as something grabbed at six in the evening.

So we did that part. Four pieces, chosen against each other rather than picked from a catalogue. The silk mask and pillowcase are cut from one run so the colour matches exactly. The journal has a morning page because the evening page is only half the job.

settings.heading: What things are made of
settings.body:
We publish the fibre, the weight and the maker for everything in the box. If a supplier will not tell us, we do not use them.

  • Silk. Grade 6A mulberry silk at 22 momme for the mask and the pillowcase, both from the same run.
  • Linen and lavender. The wrap is washed linen filled with Australian lavender and wheat, and the cover unbuttons to wash.
  • The box. Rigid board wrapped in uncoated paper, made in Victoria, sturdy enough to be reused.
  • The card. Printed on cotton stock, with your message on it, and it is the only paper in the box.

settings.heading: How a box gets packed
settings.body:
Everything is packed on one bench, in the same order every time: tissue, pillowcase, wrap, journal, mask, then the ritual card on top. Your card goes in last, above it, so your words are the first thing they see.

We do not have a shopfront. There is a studio you are welcome to collect from by appointment, which saves you the delivery wait if you are local and have left it late.

settings.heading: What we are careful not to say
settings.body: This is a box of well made things for the end of a day. Silk, linen, lavender, a journal. We describe how they feel, what they are made of and how long they last, and we do not make claims about what they will do for anyone, because that is not something a box can promise.

settings.heading: One box, made properly
settings.intro: Sleep Shop is a small studio in Melbourne. We make beautiful rituals around going to bed, starting with one box and the four pieces in it.
